notes: 150-task subset stratified by use case and type (--split parity). Original side: fork of simple-evals 652c89d at 6503101, run_hbp_parity.sh with 8 threads, Python 3.12, openai 3.48.0, CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION=2.1.322, GRADER_MODEL=gpt-5.4. Harbor side: Harbor 0.26.0 with the separate verifier, healthbench-professional_parity.yaml (8 concurrent trials), GRADER_MODEL=gpt-5.4. Claude Code 2.1.322 with claude-haiku-5-5 on both sides; judge gpt-5.4, reasoning low, on both sides through Harbor's parity API, which serves gpt-5.4 but not the dated name gpt-5.4-2026-03-05. Run score: the mean unclipped task score (length-adjusted), clipped to [0, 1] after averaging. Both sides started their three runs together; the original side finished first, and the first Harbor batch (0.5879, 0.6233, 0.5902) was discarded because image builds reused another task's record file in 7 trials (harbor#3827), then rerun after the fix (6fa4b4e). Every run graded all 150 tasks. Claude Code exited normally in all 900 reported trials; in 1 original and 3 Harbor trials it ended without writing a reply, which is graded as an empty string, as simple-evals does. Agent cost reported by Claude Code, summed over three runs: $1.40 original, $1.46 Harbor.
